summary.text: John Skirbst is the No Labels Party candidate for the Arizona House of Representatives, District 3, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He advanced from the No Labels Party primary as a write-in candidate on July 21, 2026, and was also a write-in candidate in the 2024 Democratic primary for Arizona State Senate District 3.
